The evidence is supported by a direct interaction between Acetylleucine and the transporter, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be elucidated. The relationship is supported by a clinically proven drug–disease link, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the role of Acetylleucine in the regulation of this transporter.
